documents.name: Client brief.pdf
documents.text: Shifa Clinics runs 8 family clinics. Patients send about 3,000 WhatsApp messages a week asking for appointments or describing symptoms, and wait hours for a reply. We want an AI agent that reads patient messages, understands how urgent they are, books the right appointment by itself, and immediately alerts a nurse for anything serious. Replies within 2 minutes, day and night. Never miss an emergency.
